extras: Free version available; Pro features require GitHub sponsorship.
intentEvidence: Edit a checkbox property of each note in one Bases column.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of managing different status properties (like 'watched' vs. 'read') for various types of notes within a single database column in Obsidian Bases.
summary: Bases Checkbox Router allows users to manage multiple Boolean properties of notes within a single Bases column by routing toggles to the first matching property key.
